args.message:
Fix round_money to use ROUND_HALF_EVEN per FIN-212

The docstring claimed banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN, per FIN-212), but
the implementation used ROUND_HALF_UP, causing tests/test_money.py to fail.
Switch the rounding mode to ROUND_HALF_EVEN so half-way cases round to the
nearest even cent.

\n
e.g. 2.675 -> 2.68, 2.665 -> 2.66

args.head: fix/money-half-even-fin212
args.title: Fix round_money to use ROUND_HALF_EVEN per FIN-212
args.body:
## Problem
The nightly build of `payments-service` fails: `tests/test_money.py` expects banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`, per FIN-212), but `src/money.py` implemented `ROUND_HALF_UP` despite its docstring claiming banker's rounding.

## Fix
- `src/money.py`: switch `round_money` to use `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` (banker's rounding), so half-way cases round to the nearest even cent (e.g. `2.675 -> 2.68`, `2.665 -> 2.66`).

## Testing
- CI run `ci-0001` on commit `08d3cd5986` passes (includes `tests/test_money.py`, which asserts the half-even cases).

## Ref
- FIN-212

trace.final:
The fix is merged and verified on `main`.

## Summary
- **Diagnosed:** `tests/test_money.py` expects banker's rounding per FIN-212 (e.g. `2.665 -> 2.66`), but `src/money.py` quantized with `ROUND_HALF_UP` even though its docstring already claimed `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` — the implementation simply never matched the spec.
- **Fix:** Created branch `fix/money-half-even-fin212` and changed `round_money` to use `Decimal("0.01")` quantization with `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`, matching FIN-212.
- **CI:** Triggered run `ci-0001` on commit `08d3cd5986` — **passed**, including the `test_money.py` half-even assertions.
- **PR:** Opened PR #101 (`fix/money-half-even-fin212` → `main`) with code-owner requested as reviewer.
- **Merged:** PR #101 merged (`sha: 08d3cd5986`). I also re-read `main` post-merge to confirm the shipped `src/money.py` uses `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`.

Note: since `main` is protected, the merge into it was done via the PR flow — code-owner was the requested reviewer on that PR per policy.
